description: This header file defines the AccessControl struct within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions, primarily for POSIX-compliant systems. It includes methods to set ownership (OwnerShip), permissions (Permission), and apply both settings (Apply) to files identified by NodeId objects.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A struct providing static methods to manage file ownership and permissions in a POSIX environment.

methods.name: uint32_t OwnerShip(const string & node,const string & userName,const string & groupName)
methods.description: Sets the ownership of a file specified by node, using provided username and group name strings.

methods.name: uint32_t Permission(const string & node,const uint16_t modeFlags)
methods.description: Sets the permission mode of a file specified by its path, based on modeFlags.

methods.name: uint32_t Apply(const Core::NodeId & node)
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a file represented by a NodeId object.
